description: Life sciences value chain taxonomy. Defines the phases, areas, and sub-areas that organize the Lumis knowledge base. Adding a new area here makes it discoverable by the server without code changes.

phases.name: Drug Discovery
phases.description: Target identification, lead optimization, preclinical research, and candidate selection.

phases.name: Clinical Development
phases.description: Clinical trials (Phase I–IV), regulatory submissions, CTMS, and patient recruitment.

areas.name: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS)
areas.description: Site management, protocol tracking, enrollment monitoring, study startup, and clinical operations oversight.

areas.name: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF)
areas.description: TMF reference model compliance, document lifecycle, inspection readiness, and regulatory archiving.

areas.name: Digital Trials & Decentralized Clinical Trials
areas.description: Remote monitoring, ePRO/eCOA, wearable data integration, hybrid trial design, and virtual site models.

areas.name: Clinical Trials Operations
areas.description: Protocol design, patient recruitment, randomization, data management, safety reporting, and Phase I–IV execution.

areas.name: HCP Payments & Transparency
areas.description: Investigator grants, fair market value, Sunshine Act / EFPIA disclosure, aggregate spend tracking, and payment reconciliation.

areas.name: Participant Management
areas.description: Patient recruitment, enrollment, consent, FHIR/USCDI alignment, and advanced therapy management.

areas.name: Patient Programs
areas.description: Care programs, financial assistance, benefit verification, electronic signatures for consent, and patient outcome tracking.

phases.name: Commercialization
phases.description: Go-to-market, field operations, safety monitoring, and market access after regulatory approval.

areas.name: CRM & Field Operations
areas.description: Field sales, medical affairs, KAM, CLM, events, samples, consent, territory management, and mobile CRM.

areas.name: Safety & Pharmacovigilance
areas.description: Adverse event reporting, signal detection, ICSR/CIOMS, risk management, and post-market surveillance.

areas.name: Regulated Content Management
areas.description: MLR/PRC review workflows, promotional and medical content lifecycle, digital asset management, claims and references, and regulatory submission content.

areas.name: Market Access & HEOR
areas.description: Payer engagement, health economics, outcomes research, formulary management, and reimbursement.

foundation.description: Cross-cutting knowledge that applies across all phases and areas. Always included in search results regardless of phase/area filter.

category_schema.modules: Feature descriptions, field mappings, configuration guides, and module-to-module comparisons.
category_schema.decision-trees: Structured decision logic with gates, branches, and recommendation nodes.
category_schema.gotchas: Non-obvious pitfalls, implementation gaps, and troubleshooting guides.
category_schema.country-rules: Regulatory requirements, country-specific configuration, and compliance rules.
category_schema.validation-rules: Configuration validation checklists and automated rule definitions.
category_schema.terminology: Correct vs. incorrect terminology to prevent hallucinations and ensure consistency.
